title: Implicit Neural Representations for Variational Problems on Graphons
abstract: arXiv:2610.32147v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We propose a neural exploratory framework for variational problems over graphons, i.e., symmetric measurable functions $[0,1]^2 \to [0,1]$, that arise as limits of dense graph sequences. Such problems are central to two parts of the mathematical literature: extremal graph theory, which studies graph parameter optimisation under given restrictions, often for those graphs with a large number of vertices, and the large deviation theory of dense random graphs, which characterises the structure of rare events through constrained graphon optimisation. We represent graphons by implicit neural networks and optimise graphon objectives by gradient descent. Our design combines three ingredients: a multi-scale sinusoidal residual architecture biased toward sharp, step-like graphons; an embedded solver that enforces a single empirical density constraint and is differentiated by implicit differentiation; and symmetry-aware Monte Carlo estimators. translated_title: 面向Graphon上变分问题的隐式神经表示
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一个用于求解Graphon上变分问题的神经探索框架，其中Graphon是指作为稠密图序列极限而出现的对称可测函数 $[0,1]^2 \to [0,1]$。此类问题在数学文献的两个领域中处于核心地位：其一是极值图论，它研究在给定约束下的图参数优化问题，尤其针对顶点数量巨大的图；其二是稠密随机图的大偏差理论，它通过受约束的Graphon优化来刻画稀有事件的结构。我们采用隐式神经网络来表示Graphon，并通过梯度下降来优化以Graphon为变量的目标函数。我们的设计结合了三个要素：一种偏向于尖锐、阶跃状Graphon的多尺度正弦残差架构；一个内嵌的求解器，用于强制施加单一经验密度约束，并通过隐式微分进行求导；以及对对称性敏感的蒙特卡洛估计器。
tldr: 该论文提出用隐式神经网络表示Graphon并通过梯度下降求解其上的变分问题，其创新在于结合多尺度正弦残差架构、经隐式微分的密度约束内嵌求解器以及对称性感知的蒙特卡洛估计器，服务于极值图论与稠密随机图大偏差理论。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes representing graphons with implicit neural networks and optimizing graphon variational objectives via gradient descent, combining a multi-scale sinusoidal residual architecture, an implicitly differentiated embedded solver for density constraints, and symmetry-aware Monte Carlo estimators, with applications to extremal graph theory and large deviations of dense random graphs.
